principle: Build bottom-up revenue scenarios for AI optical / rack-scale supply-chain candidates. This is research evidence, not a trading signal.

LITE.source_note: Initial template seeded from user-provided screenshot of a Claude-assisted Excel revenue build. Numbers are unverified until checked against company IR, earnings call, filings, and credible supply-chain sources.

official_sources.name: Lumentum Q3 FY26 financial results press release
official_sources.use: Q3 FY26 revenue, GAAP income statement, cash balance, risk factors

official_sources.name: Lumentum Q3 FY26 earnings presentation
official_sources.use: Components/Systems revenue, EML/CPO/DCI/pump/1.6T/OCS commentary, Q4 guidance

official_sources.name: Lumentum Q2 FY26 earnings presentation
official_sources.use: Q2 baseline, 200G EML contribution, CPO 2H CY26 ramp, OCS run-rate

lines.name: 100G EML laser chips
lines.driver: Legacy/high-volume EML path; should gradually decline as 200G ramps, but not collapse if 800G/1.6T mix still uses 100G.

lines.name: 200G EML laser chips
lines.driver: Core upside line. Requires ASP premium, InP capacity, customer qualification, and AI cluster demand validation.

lines.name: DCI long-wavelength lasers
lines.driver: DCI and hyperscaler interconnect demand; less pure than 200G but can benefit from scale-across data-center buildout.

lines.name: Pump lasers
lines.driver: Scale-across/sub-sea and optical amplification demand; supply capacity and margin quality need verification.

lines.name: CPO ultra-high-power lasers
lines.driver: Longer-dated CPO/scale-out option; high payoff but timing and standards remain less certain.

lines.name: 3D sensing VCSEL
lines.driver: Consumer/Apple-related line; not core AI thesis and should not be used to justify AI multiple expansion.

lines.name: Other industrial lasers
lines.driver: Non-core stabilizer. F3Q26A is calibrated as residual so Components subtotal matches official $533.3M.

lines.name: 800G cloud transceivers
lines.driver: Mature high-speed module cycle; may fade as 1.6T ramps.

lines.name: 1.6T cloud transceivers
lines.driver: Important AI rack-scale ramp line; requires customer qualification and volume evidence.

lines.name: OCS (R300 + R-series)
lines.driver: Optical circuit switching path; needs proof that AI network architectures adopt it at scale.

lines.name: Telecom networking
lines.driver: Legacy/networking line; secondary to AI thesis.

bear.description: 200G/CPO/1.6T ramp delayed, AI optical demand remains real but pricing and capacity upside are overestimated.

base.description: Screenshot-seeded base case. Treat as working model, not verified company guidance.

upside.description: AI rack-scale acceleration: 200G/1.6T/CPO adoption is faster and LITE captures more bottleneck economics.

current_market.source: public historical close cross-check; refresh before any future action

evidence_gates: Lumentum IR or earnings call confirms AI/datacenter demand by product line.
200G EML ramp has customer qualification, supply capacity, and margin evidence.
1.6T and CPO timing is supported by customer roadmap, not only market narrative.
Revenue growth converts into gross margin and FCF, not just lower-quality pass-through sales.
Stock price/crowding does not already price the upside case.
LITE.system_action: Use as V6AB/Radar evidence input after source validation; do not trade from the model alone.
